Who We Are

Global freight expertise, local commitment

Davoo Freight Expert Ltd connects businesses across Nigeria, Ghana and international trade routes with dependable, well-coordinated logistics. We work closely with every client to understand their shipping needs and deliver solutions built around them, not the other way around.

Our Commitment

We hold ourselves to a high standard of execution across air, ocean and land freight, customs clearance and warehousing. Logistics is a fast-moving sector, and our team stays close to every shipment from booking to final delivery.

Specialized Capability

Experts in Aero — AOG

When an aircraft is grounded, every hour counts. Davoo Freight Expert Ltd specializes in Aircraft-on-Ground (AOG) logistics — moving critical parts and components with the urgency the situation demands.

  • Priority handling for time-critical aviation parts
  • 24/7 coordination for AOG emergencies
  • Trusted by aviation operators across our network
